Gwen.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain first, then trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down and you can keep the fight going, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of her escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack. Gwen cannot be targeted from outside Gwen W Hallowed Mist, so check her position before using Trundle R Subjugate.
Gwen.build: To counter Gwen's healing, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items and keep its wounds effect active with basic attacks. Build magic resistance first against her main damage, and get some armor too against her basic attacks. Since she deals damage based on your maximum health, do not rely on a large health increase alone.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is her mobility skill, so the moment after you make her use it is your chance to go in. Chase her with Trundle W Frozen Domain to stay close and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of the direction Gwen is heading. Move at an angle that lets you avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! as you fight.
Gwen.fight: Trade early, before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight ahead of time, and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. After you make Gwen use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, block her escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and chase her to stay close.
Gwen.laning: Keep the wave in the center and pressure Gwen when she steps up to last-hit. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash makes it easy for her to escape near a large minion wave, so set up the fight on the side without minions. Trundle E Pillar of Ice is also needed to respond to ganks, so do not use it for every trade. If health has decreased, also look for a chance to recover when minions die with Trundle P King's Tribute.
Gwen.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, and before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks is your chance to trade. Later, Trundle lacks area damage and contributes less to teamfights, so hold one opponent on the side lane.
Gwen.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set up the fight, split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the separated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on a tanky enemy at the very front to lower their armor and magic resistance. Gwen R Needlework deals area damage based on maximum health, so avoid grouping up and taking hits for an extended period, and move out of the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so step to the side when she casts it. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, she cannot be targeted from outside the mist, so use Trundle R Subjugate after entering the mist or once it ends. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid extended fights where you keep taking hits.

Chogath.laning: Early on, pressure Cho’Gath when he steps up to last-hit, but avoid standing behind minions in the straight-line path of Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Keep the wave near the center to limit the time Cho’Gath has to stack, and look for a gank from your jungler right after Cho’Gath uses Cho’Gath Q Rupture on the wave. If you need to prepare for a gank, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice instead of using it to trade.
Chogath.build: Fit Executioner’s Calling between core items to reduce healing from Cho’Gath P Carnivore. Cho’Gath R Feast’s true damage can’t be blocked with resistances.
Chogath.combo: Dodge Cho’Gath Q Rupture and cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If you can fight for longer, cast Trundle R Subjugate early, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Cho’Gath’s escape route, then follow with Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Chogath.escape: The window to engage is after Cho’Gath Q Rupture misses or has been used on the wave. Avoid the front of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream as you go in, and if Cho’Gath backs off, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. If you’re caught by his crowd control and need to create distance, place the pillar between yourself and Cho’Gath.
Chogath.fight: After dodging Cho’Gath Q Rupture, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you’ll fight and engage. Weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to increase your attack damage, and if Cho’Gath backs off, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path. Use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight to steal Cho’Gath’s health and defensive stats.
Chogath.phase: Early on, use Trundle’s strong basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp to pressure Cho’Gath and limit his time to stack. In the late game, Cho’Gath becomes harder to deal with as he stacks, so Trundle should keep one opponent occupied in a side lane.
Chogath.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation to set the fight location. Split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and attack the separated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the tanky frontline Cho’Gath to steal armor and magic resistance.
Chogath.watch: When you see the marker beneath your feet from Cho’Gath Q Rupture, immediately walk to the side to dodge the knock-up. In front of Cho’Gath, his silence from Cho’Gath W Feral Scream can be followed by Cho’Gath Q Rupture, so move to the side. If you’re at or below half health, create distance to avoid Cho’Gath R Feast’s true damage.

Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so don't start a trade right afterward. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash and can't be interrupted by Trundle E Pillar of Ice. When you can't see Malphite, don't group with allies near walls or bushes.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Instead of focusing only on breaking through Malphite's high armor head-on, use Trundle R Subjugate to steal armor and deal damage based on maximum health.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and attack with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If you can keep fighting, cast Trundle R Subjugate early to steal Malphite's armor and magic resistance. When Malphite backs off, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path.
Malphite.escape: At this point, placing Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Malphite's escape route makes it difficult for him to get away. By contrast, don't engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.fight: Start trading only after breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, when you can damage his actual health. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in advance where you plan to fight and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. Don't force a chase right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.laning: Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to ganks or block an escape route when your jungler arrives. If health has decreased, clear the wave while using Trundle P King's Tribute to recover when a nearby enemy unit dies.
Malphite.phase: In the late game, Trundle lacks area damage, so take the role of holding one opponent in the side lane.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't knock up several of you at once. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split the enemy formation, then cast Trundle R Subjugate on Malphite as the frontline once a fight starts. Immediately after Malphite R Unstoppable Force has been used, focus the separated enemies first.

Aatrox.escape: The moment after you bait Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your window to close the gap. Avoid the crowd control from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains before going in, then block his remaining escape route with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. Trundle has no ability to escape on his own, so don’t recklessly commit when you haven’t avoided these attacks.
Aatrox.phase: Trundle is strong in basic-attack fights early, but Aatrox also scales quickly if he gets an early lead, so it’s important not to give up kills. In the late game, Trundle lacks area damage, so take the role of keeping one opponent occupied in a side lane.
Aatrox.build: Since Aatrox’s main damage is physical, build armor first. If the duel runs long because of Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Aatrox has relatively high armor, so consider penetration to boost Trundle’s physical damage.
Aatrox.combo: For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. After Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, when you commit to a full engage, use Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Aatrox.fight: Look for a trade just after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you’ll fight, then use Trundle Q Chomp to steal attack damage and weaken Aatrox’s retaliation. Immediately after Aatrox uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and stick to him.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, avoid giving Aatrox a kill, collect CS, and keep the wave near the center. Stay at a distance where you can avoid the outer hit of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, and pressure him when the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance has been used on a minion. If you need to prepare for a gank, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block the approach instead of using it to trade.
Aatrox.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation to set the fight location, then split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and attack the isolated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to reduce their armor and increase Trundle’s armor.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and knocks you up. When you see him cast it, move outside the blade-tip area or move inward toward him. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, immediately leave the area to avoid being pulled back in. Aatrox R World Ender increases his healing, so don’t take a duel; create distance and wait out its duration.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. You don’t need to prioritize magic resistance specifically against Poppy.
Poppy.combo: For a basic trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then attack in this order: basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack → basic attack. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and you can stay on her, use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of her escape path.
Poppy.escape: Immediately after you bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, dodge to the side first, then decide whether to engage once the threat of being knocked away has passed.
Poppy.fight: Trade briefly in open space away from walls when Poppy steps up to last-hit. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. Once Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, look for a chance to block her escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and close in.
Poppy.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Poppy when she steps forward without standing with a wall behind you. When Poppy P Iron Ambassador’s shield falls to the ground, check whether you can safely step on it to prevent her from retrieving it. If the wave pushes out and you could be ganked, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to use on the enemy’s approach path.
Poppy.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, but his abilities alone don’t deal burst damage. He contributes less to teamfights later because he has no area damage, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Poppy.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then focus the isolated side first. Once the fight starts, if Poppy is on the front line, use Trundle R Subjugate to lower her armor and magic resistance. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move from in front of her to the side.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns if it hits a wall, so stand in open space with no wall behind you. If you’re hit by Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before its second burst. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move from in front of her to the side.

Volibear.fight: Don't accept a fight when Volibear approaches with stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm; after the stacks fall off, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain to set up where to fight. In short trades, weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to lower his attack damage. When you can stay on him for a long fight, use Trundle R Subjugate early and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in Volibear's escape route.
Volibear.build: Fit Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Build armor first against Volibear's main damage from Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Volibear P The Relentless Storm and E Sky Splitter deal magic damage, and E Sky Splitter scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Volibear.combo: For a basic trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain under your opponent and follow with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If you have an opening to keep Volibear from getting away throughout the fight, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape direction → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack. Move sideways and keep fighting when the indicator for Volibear E Sky Splitter appears.
Volibear.escape: The opening to engage comes after Volibear uses the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Volibear R Stormbringer is also down and hasn't returned, block his escape route with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and stick to him. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, he can escape with R Stormbringer, so don't rush your engage.
Volibear.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Volibear with Trundle Q Chomp on Trundle W Frozen Domain when he steps up to last-hit. If health has decreased, use Trundle P King's Tribute, which restores health when nearby minions die, to clear the wave. When the lane is pushed and you could be ganked, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block the jungler's entry path.
Volibear.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, but avoid fights while Volibear has stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm. Your teamfight impact falls later because you have no area damage, so focus on holding one opponent in place on a side lane.
Volibear.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation, then split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and go after the isolated side first. Once the fight is underway, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to lower their armor and magic resistance and increase Trundle's defensive stats. If Volibear approaches with stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm, don't meet him head-on; wait for the stacks to fall off.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash speeds him up as he approaches, then stuns you. If you see it activated, wait it out beyond basic attack range, and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice between you and Volibear if he chases. If you see the indicator for Volibear E Sky Splitter, move sideways to avoid its damage and slow, and watch the direction Volibear will approach from to get the shield. Avoid fighting while Volibear has stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm, and don't stay under your turret at low health while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.

Aurora.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the separated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to reduce their armor and increase your defensive stats. If Aurora jumps in and no one is killed, it’s a chance to catch her; when backing off, make sure no low-health ally is left behind.
Aurora.build: If Aurora sustains through Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Q Twofold Hex, and E The Weirding deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration also deals damage based on max health, so don’t rely on building health alone to survive.
Aurora.combo: After Aurora’s escape options are down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and Trundle R Subjugate, then place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of her escape route. Once you’re on her, attack with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. While Aurora W Across the Veil keeps her hidden, wait until she becomes visible again.
Aurora.escape: The opportunity to engage is when Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are both down and she can’t use R Between Worlds. Then follow with Trundle W Frozen Domain, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Aurora’s path, and use Q Chomp. If only one movement ability is down, she can still escape with the other, so check that it’s been used too.
Aurora.fight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you’ll fight, then engage for a short trade when Aurora steps up to last-hit. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, wait until she becomes visible again, and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in her expected escape direction. If you use Trundle R Subjugate while Aurora still has a movement ability available, it’ll be hard to stick to her, so check her escape options before starting a fight.
Aurora.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Aurora with Trundle W Frozen Domain and Q Chomp when she steps up to last-hit. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to ganks, and if you’re ganked, place it along the enemy jungler’s approach path. When health has decreased, use Trundle P King’s Tribute, which restores health when nearby minions die, to clear the wave.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Trundle is strong in basic-attack fights, but using Trundle E Pillar of Ice to trade as well can quickly cost you mana and your gank defense. In the late game, Trundle’s lack of area damage reduces his teamfight contribution, so keep one opponent occupied in a side lane.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases with missing health. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself, and if your health is low, back off before the recall. After Aurora R Between Worlds forms, you’re slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to leave before the zone forms or fight inside it.

Kayle.build: Buy Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Prioritize magic resistance over armor to defend against Kayle's damage. It's also important to dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast, since it reduces magic resistance.
Kayle.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain under Kayle and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. When you can reliably get on top of her, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice on Kayle's escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, attack again once her damage immunity ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no movement ability, so dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast and waiting until after she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing are good opportunities to get on top of her. If she also uses Kayle R Divine Judgment, fight once her damage immunity ends. Chase by placing Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of Kayle's escape path.
Kayle.fight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then stay close and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. If Kayle uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing to escape, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of her path.
Kayle.laning: Keep the lane near the center early and pressure Kayle when she comes forward to last-hit, denying her CS and experience. When you have lost health, use Trundle P King's Tribute to heal when nearby minions die. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to ganks, but use it to block Kayle's escape route when your jungler comes.
Kayle.phase: In the mid game, secure your lead with objectives and towers. In the late game, when Kayle has scaled further, avoid front-to-front team fights against her and create a numbers advantage in a side lane or away from Kayle.
Kayle.teamfight: Look for a route to reach Kayle from the flank or out of vision instead of walking straight at her, and time your engage with your team's crowd control. Use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block Kayle's escape route or wait out the damage immunity from Kayle R Divine Judgment. If you can engage the frontline, use Trundle R Subjugate on a durable enemy to make them easier for your team to take down.
Kayle.watch: Avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on your missing health.

Kled.build: Kled's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Consider tenacity because Trundle has no movement ability to escape and can easily be hit by consecutive crowd control effects. Lowering the attack speed of Kled W Violent Tendencies increases the time it takes him to land the fourth attack.
Kled.escape: Even if Kled E Jousting has been used, Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can still let him escape a chase, so don't rush your engage. Look for an opportunity before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up, and when Kled E Jousting is also down, use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block his escape route. If you get caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, prioritize getting away before you are pulled over engaging.
Kled.fight: When Kled comes forward to last-hit, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and start trading with Trundle Q Chomp. When Kled W Violent Tendencies activates, don't stay and take all four attacks; back off, then engage again. If you get caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance before you get pulled.
Kled.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Kled when he comes forward to last-hit. Don't spend Trundle E Pillar of Ice on trades; save it to respond to ganks. Kled dismounted from Skaarl also gains courage from killing minions, so after dismounting him, push him away from the lane to deny him farm.
Kled.phase: Pressure early with Trundle's basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp, but don't let Kled's repeated engages catch you and keep you taking damage for too long. Kled gets weaker after the laning phase and mid game, so deny him an early lead. In the late game, Trundle can tie up one opponent in a side lane.
Kled.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from the flank and out of vision, so watch the approach routes in advance. Instead of walking straight at the enemy, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split the enemy formation. Once a fight breaks out, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to reduce their armor, then clear the separated side first.
Kled.watch: If you get caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, use Trundle W Frozen Domain to create distance before you get pulled. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, the fourth attack's max-health damage is dangerous, so get away before taking all four attacks. Keep watching your distance, since Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can let him close the gap again.
Kled.combo: For a short trade, use Trundle W Frozen Domain, then basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. For a longer fight, use Trundle W Frozen Domain to take your position, cast Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight, then place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route and land Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.

Akali.build: Build magic resistance first to defend against Akali’s main damage. Akali R Perfect Execution’s second strike gets stronger based on missing health, so build health as well. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of the announced attack area.
Akali.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you’ll fight, and if you’ve closed the gap, use Trundle R Subjugate early. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Akali’s escape route, then follow with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If you need the pillar to interrupt Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution’s engage, save it for that moment.
Akali.escape: Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution can all help her escape, so don’t go deep just because one is down. In particular, before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, wait for her other movement options to be down, then block her escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and go in.
Akali.fight: Weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to build up physical damage. If Akali starts to run, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of her path.
Akali.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Akali when she steps up to last-hit. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to ganks, and when health has decreased, sustain with Trundle P King’s Tribute, which triggers when nearby minions die. Push and recall when Akali backs off or leaves the lane.
Akali.phase: In the late game, you lack area damage, so keep one opponent occupied in a side lane.
Akali.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. Take down the separated side first, and once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to steal their defensive stats.
Akali.watch: If you’re marked, the second dash follows you even if you retreat.

Camille.build: Build armor first to defend against Camille’s main damage. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage can’t be reduced by armor, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on max health, so be careful about relying solely on a large increase in health. If the healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Camille.combo: If Camille tries to escape with Camille E Hookshot, interrupt the leap with Trundle E Pillar of Ice the moment her hook attaches to a wall. For a long fight, cast Trundle R Subjugate early so its damage and defensive-stat theft can be applied in full.
Camille.escape: After interrupting or baiting out Camille E Hookshot, you have a chance to engage, but check whether Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available. Before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up, it’s a good time to block her escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and chase. When Camille engages with her ultimate, don’t use your response ability right away; wait out the duration of the area trapping you, then counterattack.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield, and engage after the shield has been removed. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you’ll fight, then weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to gain attack damage while reducing Camille’s. If Camille starts to run, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of her path.
Camille.laning: Early on, pressure Camille when she steps up to last-hit, but stand among minions and away from walls. Keep the wave near the center and stay within range to engage, while saving Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to Camille E Hookshot or a gank. Take control and pressure her farming before Camille gets her first core item.
Camille.phase: Early on, Trundle can pressure with basic-attack fights, and Camille is weakest before she gets her first core item. In the late game, Trundle contributes less to teamfights, so keep an opponent occupied in a side lane, but don’t leave the lane unattended because Camille can take down turrets quickly.
Camille.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation to set the fight location. Use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to interrupt Camille’s engage or split the enemy formation, then take down the isolated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to steal their defensive stats.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot can use a wall to engage from a long distance and stun you, so stand away from walls. The moment her hook attaches to a wall, interrupt the leap with the forced movement from Trundle E Pillar of Ice.

Darius.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling between core items to reduce healing from Darius Q Decimate. Build armor first to defend against Darius’s main physical damage, but build health as well to account for the penetration from Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Darius.combo: For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Darius E Apprehend is down and you can stay on him, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack. When Darius uses Darius Q Decimate, move away from the blade’s edge or get very close.
Darius.escape: Go in while Darius E Apprehend has missed or is unavailable to recast. Conversely, when you need to back off as bleed stacks build, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice between yourself and Darius.
Darius.fight: After Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, go in for a short trade and back off. Attack on Trundle W Frozen Domain while using Trundle Q Chomp to reduce Darius’s attack damage. If Darius P Hemorrhage starts stacking, end the fight, then pressure him again right after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions.
Darius.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Darius with Trundle W Frozen Domain when he steps up to last-hit. Save Trundle Q Chomp for the trade, and keep Trundle E Pillar of Ice available to respond to ganks when the lane is pushed. When health has decreased, recover with Trundle P King’s Tribute, which triggers when nearby minions die, and push and recall only when Darius has backed off.
Darius.phase: Trundle is strong in basic-attack fights early, but watch out for Darius’s early skirmishes and dives, and keep trades short. In the late game, Trundle lacks area damage, so keep one opponent occupied in a side lane.
Darius.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the isolated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the tanky frontline to reduce the enemy’s armor and increase your own. If Darius kills you with Darius R Noxian Guillotine while you have several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage, his ultimate resets, so stay out of range when your health is low.
Darius.watch: If you’re pulled in by Darius E Apprehend, it’s easy to get hit by follow-up attacks, so stay out of its range and approach after it misses. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, his attack damage rises sharply, so create distance to let the stacks expire. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move beyond the blade’s edge or get very close to reduce his healing. If you have several bleed stacks and low health, get completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine’s range.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first to block the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper. If healing makes the duel run long, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items and keep its wound effect active with Trundle’s steady basic attacks.
DrMundo.combo: Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to remove his passive first. When you fully commit, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and Trundle R Subjugate, then attack in the order basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp → basic attack. If his passive is down and Mundo runs, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path to block his escape.
DrMundo.escape: The window to engage is when Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw misses or is blocked by a minion and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so follow with Trundle W Frozen Domain and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in his escape direction. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available, look for another advantage instead of fixating on killing him.
DrMundo.fight: After Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by a minion or misses, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you’ll fight and engage. Weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to increase your attack damage and reduce Mundo’s. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down, cast Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight and stay on him.
DrMundo.laning: Keep the wave near the center and trade with Trundle W Frozen Domain and Q Chomp when Dr. Mundo steps up to last-hit. Keep a minion between you and Mundo to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and when backing off after a trade, step on the canister Mundo drops to deny both his healing and the reduction of his passive's cooldown. Trundle E Pillar of Ice is also needed to respond to ganks, so don’t use it for every trade.
DrMundo.phase: In the late game, your lack of area damage reduces your teamfight contribution, so keep one opponent occupied in a side lane.
DrMundo.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation to set the fight location. Split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, and once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on a tanky frontline like Dr. Mundo to reduce armor and magic resistance. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, don’t spend time trying to kill Mundo; take down the separated side first.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target it encounters and deals damage based on current health, so be especially careful when health is high and stand behind minions. When Dr. Mundo activates Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, he heals and gains movement speed, so don’t spend time trying to kill him during its duration.

Fiora.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. The true damage from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge can’t be blocked by armor, and they also deal damage based on max health, so be careful about choosing to stack large amounts of health alone. If healing helps her survive a long duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Fiora.combo: For a basic trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Fiora W Riposte is down and she has also used Fiora Q Lunge, follow with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of her escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Fiora.escape: The moment after you bait Fiora Q Lunge is your window to close the gap. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Fiora’s escape route and engage. When Riposte is available, she can counter the pillar’s forced movement, so don’t rush the engage.
Fiora.fight: When Fiora steps up to last-hit or dives in to target a vital, stand opposite the vital and counterattack briefly. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you’ll fight first, then weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to steal attack damage. After you bait out Fiora W Riposte, the moment she also uses Fiora Q Lunge is your chance to commit and stay close.
Fiora.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Fiora when she comes to last-hit. Don’t waste Trundle Q Chomp on minions; save it for trades, and if there’s a risk of a gank, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block the approach. If health has decreased, clear the wave while using Trundle P King’s Tribute to recover health when nearby minions die.
Fiora.phase: Early on, look for short trades with Trundle’s strong basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp.
Fiora.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team’s formation and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the separated side first. Once a fight breaks out, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline. Allies hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge should stand against a wall so they don’t expose all four vitals.
Fiora.watch: Watch for Fiora to move toward the direction of the vital from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance, and if you’re hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to block one of the vitals.

Gangplank.build: Build armor early against Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and the physical damage from Gangplank E Powder Keg. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy prolongs the fight, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Resistances do not affect the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so consider your total health as well.
Gangplank.combo: For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then use basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. Start a longer fight with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate. Once Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape route and chase him with Trundle Q Chomp to stay close.
Gangplank.escape: Go in just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, while it is still fresh. Once Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, he cannot cleanse the crowd control from Trundle E Pillar of Ice, making it a good way to block his escape. Gangplank has no skill that creates distance on his own, so once you catch him, you have a chance to keep chasing.
Gangplank.fight: The moment after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed is your chance to engage and trade. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, block his escape route with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and stay on him.
Gangplank.laning: Keep the wave in the center and pressure Gangplank when he steps up to last-hit. Back off if there is an aged Gangplank E Powder Keg nearby, and save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to a gank. If health has decreased, you can recover from the minion wave with Trundle P King's Tribute.
Gangplank.phase: Trundle contributes less to teamfights later in the game, so hold one opponent on the side lane.
Gangplank.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, use Trundle W Frozen Domain to set up the fight in front of your allies, then split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the toughest enemy frontline to steal their defensive stats. Check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage is available to time fights around objectives.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg gets more dangerous as it ages, so engage in front of a freshly placed keg and back off from an aged keg or a spot where two kegs overlap. You can destroy a keg yourself from outside its explosion radius. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy cleanses crowd control and heals him, so watch whether he uses it when Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks his escape route.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice's true damage cannot be reduced by armor or magic resistance, so build health too. If Garen sustains through Garen P Perseverance, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Garen.combo: When Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack is used, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade briefly with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If the fight looks likely to continue, cast Trundle R Subjugate early, and avoid the moment when Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity before placing Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape route.
Garen.escape: Garen has no skill that creates distance, so engage after the empowered basic attack that applies Garen Q Decisive Strike's silence is used. Once the brief moment after Garen W Courage activates has passed, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. When disengaging, place the pillar between you and Garen.
Garen.fight: Start a short trade just after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack is used. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks, but do not stay close for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning. Delay Trundle E Pillar of Ice by half a beat right after Garen W Courage activates.
Garen.laning: Pressure Garen when he steps up to last-hit from the early game onward, giving him less room to build stacks on Garen W Courage. Keep the wave in the center and stay close enough to engage; push and recall when Garen backs off or leaves lane. If the wave is pushed and you are in a position to be ganked, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to place in the jungler's approach path.
Garen.phase: In the early game, slow Garen's growth by pressuring him with basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp. Garen W Courage's growing stacks put you at a disadvantage as the game goes on, so later hold one opponent on the side lane instead of looking for area damage in teamfights.
Garen.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set up the fight. Split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and deal with the separated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the toughest frontline to lower their defensive stats and make yourself tankier.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his next basic attack to silence you and stop your retaliation, so do not engage first while he has it available. Once Garen E Judgment starts spinning, staying close only puts you at a disadvantage, so leave its range. If your health is below half, beware of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health, and stay out of range.

Gnar.build: Build armor first to mitigate Gnar's main damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about relying on health alone. If you are at high risk of being knocked into a wall by Mega Gnar R GNAR!, consider tenacity too.
Gnar.combo: If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight. Then place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape route and attack in this order: basic attack, Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack, basic attack.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch is your window to close the gap. Delay your engage if Mega Gnar still has crowd control available or can knock you into a wall, then engage again just after he changes from Mega to Mini.
Gnar.fight: The moment after Gnar changes from Mega to Mini is your chance to engage. Make Gnar use Gnar E Hop / Crunch, then chase him with Trundle W Frozen Domain to stay close and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape route. Weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks when trading.
Gnar.laning: While taking ranged poke from Mini Gnar, do not chase recklessly; if you cannot get in range, farm near your turret. Keep the wave in the center and try to trade on Trundle W Frozen Domain when Gnar steps up to last-hit. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice when you need to prepare for a gank.
Gnar.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, but account for Mini Gnar's ranged poke and choose a moment when you can get on him. Later, Trundle lacks area damage, so hold one opponent on the side lane.
Gnar.teamfight: Be mindful of Gnar R GNAR!: do not fight with your back to a wall or engage head-on in narrow terrain. Just after Gnar changes from Mega to Mini, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain to set up the fight, then split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline.
Gnar.watch: Mini Gnar Q Boomerang Throw can hit both on the way out and on the return, so step out of its path. Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns when it knocks you into a wall, so do not fight with your back to one. Avoid direct fights when his Rage is high and his transformation is near.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi can sustain through Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, so buy Executioner's Calling between your core items and keep its healing reduction active with basic attacks. Build armor first because Illaoi's main damage is physical. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about relying on a large health increase alone.
Illaoi.combo: When Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If you can stay on her for a longer fight, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of her escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in advance in the direction Illaoi wants to go.
Illaoi.escape: The moment after Illaoi uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your chance to engage if you dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit. At that point, chase her with Trundle W Frozen Domain to stay close and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in her escape direction.
Illaoi.fight: The moment after you make Illaoi use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your chance to engage. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain away from the tentacles, then trade by weaving Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to lower her attack damage. Even if Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, fight back instead of only running if the situation lets you fight.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave in the center, stay away from walls, and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range. When Illaoi steps up to last-hit, trade briefly with Trundle Q Chomp on Trundle W Frozen Domain. If the wave is pushed and you could be ganked, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block the approach path.
Illaoi.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, but conserve mana and keep trades short. Later, Trundle contributes less to teamfights because he lacks area damage, so hold one opponent on the side lane.
Illaoi.teamfight: Do not group up in front of Illaoi R Leap of Faith; if she uses it, spread out and wait out its duration. Break the tentacles or draw Illaoi into open ground away from walls to fight. Use Trundle W Frozen Domain to set up the fight, split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then cast Trundle R Subjugate on the frontline once a fight breaks out.
Illaoi.watch: If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, it slows and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range to avoid it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith is a powerful area damage window; if she uses it, spread out and wait out its duration. Fight in open ground to avoid tentacles near walls and Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance, her main damage sources. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Irelia.combo: For a basic trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then use basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of her escape route. When you can engage and stay on her, use Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Irelia.escape: Go in just after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun is down too, it is a good time to stay on her and fight; block her escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Irelia.fight: The moment after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used is your chance to close the gap. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, and stay on her with basic attacks alongside Trundle Q Chomp. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in the direction she is trying to retreat.
Irelia.phase: Later, Trundle contributes less to teamfights because he lacks area damage, so hold one opponent on the side lane.
Irelia.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, creating an opportunity to isolate or take out the dangerous Irelia first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the toughest enemy frontline to lower their armor and make yourself tankier.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain approaches by dashing through low-health minions, so create distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you are trapped in Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed for his damage, so first consider defenses that reduce attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.combo: When Jax E Counter Strike is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp → basic attack. If you can fight for longer, cast Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in Jax's escape route.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike and after Jax E Counter Strike ends are your chances to engage. Then block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and keep him close with Trundle Q Chomp.
Jax.fight: After Jax E Counter Strike is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and engage. Weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks, and if Jax backs off, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in his path.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee fight, so do not engage recklessly.
Jax.phase: In the late game, focus on holding one opponent in the side lane with Trundle.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, do not group up around him; wait for the area stun to end. Use Trundle W Frozen Domain to set up the fight in front of your allies and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then cast Trundle R Subjugate on the frontline once a fight breaks out.
Jax.watch: Jax can close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike, so do not use Trundle E Pillar of Ice carelessly.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and movement speed is useful for getting out of its telegraphed area.
Jayce.combo: For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then use basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. When you have a chance for a longer fight, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce Q To the Skies!'s leap is used is your chance to close the gap. If Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback is down too, follow up with Trundle W Frozen Domain and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in his escape route.
Jayce.fight: When Jayce has his cannon out, avoid ranged poke and watch your spacing. Just after he uses Jayce Q To the Skies!, close in with Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade while reducing his attack damage with Trundle Q Chomp. If Jayce starts to run, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of him.
Jayce.laning: Jayce's poke is strong early, so farm while dodging the straight path of Jayce Q Shock Blast from side to side. Keep the wave in the center and look to trade on Trundle W Frozen Domain when Jayce steps up to last-hit. If you are in a position to be ganked, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to use in the approach path.
Jayce.phase: Jayce's pressure is strong early, so farm defensively if you are pushed in. In the late game, hold one opponent in the side lane.
Jayce.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then deal with the separated side first. Once a fight breaks out, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to lower their armor and make yourself tankier. The moment Jayce's leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! has been used, look for a chance to get on him too.
Jayce.watch: If you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so step sideways out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Kennen.build: Trundle has no mobility, and Kennen's area stun is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. Then build magic resistance against Kennen's magic damage, and consider movement speed to get out of announced attack ranges.
Kennen.combo: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Kennen runs, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path. For an all-in with your ultimate, use Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Kennen.escape: After Kennen uses Kennen E Lightning Rush for movement, Trundle has an opportunity to engage. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, stop your engage and back off; re-engage after the marks disappear.
Kennen.fight: The moment Kennen E Lightning Rush has been used up, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and close the distance. Once you're on him, weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Kennen's escape route. If his marks have stacked twice, back off first to avoid the stun.
Kennen.laning: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and only step forward briefly to last-hit. Keep the wave near the center so you can close the gap when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. Even if health has decreased, take advantage of Trundle P King's Tribute, which provides healing when a nearby enemy unit dies.
Kennen.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack trades early, but choose your opportunities while blocking Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. In the late game, Trundle lacks area damage in teamfights, so hold one opponent in the side lane.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out so Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom doesn't hit several allies, and use vision to check the engage location. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split the enemy formation. Once a fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the frontline to lower its armor and magic resistance.
Kennen.watch: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken with minions in front of you. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off to avoid the third mark and stun. In teamfights, spread out from allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.

KSante.build: Build a way to penetrate K'Sante's high armor. Get armor against his main damage, but prioritize tenacity if you get locked down by repeated crowd control. Build enough health to withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker, and make sure your team has healing reduction for a long teamfight.
KSante.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. When you can stay on him for a longer fight, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack. If K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, dodge the charge before using your pillar and damage.
KSante.escape: If only one of K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork is down, don't chase too far; he can escape with the remaining mobility tool. Look for a window before K'Sante R All Out becomes available again, when his other mobility tools or crowd control are also down, and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block his escape before engaging.
KSante.fight: When K'Sante steps up to last-hit, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade briefly with Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. Don't commit damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging; dodge to the side, then re-engage. When K'Sante R All Out is active and his armor is lower, focus your damage on him, but don't mindlessly stay in the fight since his damage and life steal are also stronger.
KSante.laning: Keep the wave near the center and apply pressure, saving Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to ganks. If health has decreased, clear minions and use Trundle P King's Tribute to recover.
KSante.phase: In the late game, Trundle contributes less to teamfights, so hold one opponent in the side lane.
KSante.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split K'Sante from his team. Once a fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the durable frontline to lower its armor and raise Trundle's. While K'Sante R All Out is active, don't let him hit several allies at once; focus him with your team's healing reduction.
KSante.watch: If you get hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes repeatedly, watch for the pull and stun on his next Q and move out of range. When K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, it grants him Unstoppable and damage reduction, so dodge to the side of his charge. Don't stand with a wall behind you, so K'Sante R All Out can't knock you through it.

Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against Mordekaiser's main ability damage. You also need armor against his basic attacks, but avoid building heavily into health alone because of Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. If healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Mordekaiser.combo: If you have an opening for a long fight, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight. Then place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route and attack with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield is active, focus your damage after it has been depleted or converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.escape: When Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, you have an opportunity to engage without being pulled. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance on his own, so after you get close, chase by placing Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route. When you need to disengage, place the pillar between you and Mordekaiser.
Mordekaiser.fight: Start with short trades and back off before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Once Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield has been depleted or converted into healing, fight at close range on Trundle W Frozen Domain. If you have an opening for a long fight, cast Trundle R Subjugate early to steal his defensive stats.
Mordekaiser.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Mordekaiser with Trundle W Frozen Domain and Trundle Q Chomp when he steps up to last-hit. Back off after a short trade to reduce the chance of activating Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. If you're in a position to be ganked, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block the approach, and recover lost health with Trundle P King's Tribute when a minion dies.
Mordekaiser.phase: Early on, use Trundle's strong basic attacks to pressure Mordekaiser when he steps up to last-hit, but don't stay on him long enough to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. In the late game, Trundle lacks area damage, so shift to holding one opponent in the side lane.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split the enemy formation, then focus the isolated side first. Spread out from your allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can't pull several of you at once. Once a fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to weaken them and make yourself durable.
Mordekaiser.watch: Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can pull several people, so spread out from your allies when positioned in front of him and dodge it. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after he hits you three times with abilities or basic attacks, so trade briefly and back off. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range expecting help from allies.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main damage source. Account for the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands, but prioritize staying out of Nasus E Spirit Fire's area. Avoid building heavily into health alone because Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on your maximum health.
Nasus.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Nasus runs, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path. For a fight using Trundle R Subjugate, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block his escape → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Nasus.escape: When Nasus W Wither is down, you have a good opportunity to engage. Nasus has no way to create distance on his own other than Flash, so when you have an opening, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in his escape route to keep him close. When backing off, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice between you and Nasus.
Nasus.fight: Use Trundle Q Chomp to lower Nasus's attack damage, then keep up your basic attacks on Trundle W Frozen Domain. Back off while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Don't push the wave all the way to Nasus's turret; keep it near the center or your side and pressure him when he steps up to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. If the wave pushes toward your side, call your jungler and save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to a gank or block an escape route. Push and recall when Nasus backs off or leaves the lane.
Nasus.phase: Nasus becomes harder to deal with over time because of his Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks, so in the late game take the role of holding one opponent in the side lane.
Nasus.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split the enemy formation. Once a fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the frontline to steal defensive stats, then clear the isolated side first. Don't face Nasus while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active unless you have an advantage; keep your distance.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither lowers movement and attack speed, making it difficult for Trundle to trade with basic attacks. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, his health and defensive stats increase, so avoid fighting until it ends unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage. Nasus E Spirit Fire lowers your armor, so move out of the area.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing's true damage can't be reduced with resistances, so build health as well.
Olaf.combo: When Olaf R Ragnarok is inactive and you have an opening to engage, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Olaf's escape route, then attack with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack.
Olaf.escape: After Olaf Q Undertow is thrown, approach when he can't retrieve the axe. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance; after it ends, engage while using Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block his escape route.
Olaf.fight: When Olaf can't retrieve his axe, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and trade with Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. Olaf gains attack speed and life steal as his health gets lower, so don't commit to staying on him just because he's at half health.
Olaf.laning: Keep the wave near the center and trade briefly when Olaf steps up to last-hit. Avoid where Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands to prevent him from picking it up, and save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to respond to ganks. If health has decreased, Trundle P King's Tribute can provide healing when a minion dies.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so it's important not to give him a kill. In the late game, Trundle contributes less to teamfights, so hold one opponent in the side lane.
Olaf.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split the enemy formation, then attack the isolated side first. Once a fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to lower its armor and make yourself durable. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't rely on Trundle E Pillar of Ice to hinder his movement.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow lowers armor and applies a slow, so move in the opposite direction from where the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can't reduce, so create distance when health is low. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, movement-impairing effects don't work on him, so save Trundle E Pillar of Ice until it ends.

Ornn.build: Ornn deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on just one resistance. Trundle has no ability to escape on his own, making him susceptible to Ornn’s crowd control chains, so consider tenacity before resistances. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then attack in this order: basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack → basic attack. For a long fight after Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down, use Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Ornn’s escape path → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack.
Ornn.escape: If only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, don’t go too deep, since Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Engage while both abilities are down and block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. If Ornn W Bellows Breath applies Brittle, wait for it to wear off before closing in.
Ornn.fight: Start fights away from walls and the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. When both Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and close in. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate to steal Ornn’s armor and magic resistance.
Ornn.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Ornn with Trundle W Frozen Domain when he steps up to last-hit. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense instead of using it casually in short trades. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, engage and attack to interrupt him.
Ornn.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, while Ornn’s damage is low, so look for chances to gain an advantage in lane. Trundle contributes less to teamfights later, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Ornn.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the isolated side first. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate on Ornn at the front line to weaken him and increase Trundle’s defensive stats. When you see Ornn R Call of the Forge God, move out of the straight line between Ornn and the elemental, and also avoid the path Ornn redirects it along when he strikes it.
Ornn.watch: Stand away from the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls. Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up near either, so move toward open space when the pillar appears. If you’re hit by the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, keep your distance until Brittle wears off.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. However, Pantheon R Grand Starfall’s penetration means more of your armor will be ignored as you stack it. Pantheon’s high armor also blocks Trundle’s physical damage, so include penetration in your build and use Trundle R Subjugate in fights to lower his armor.
Pantheon.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then use Trundle R Subjugate early when Pantheon can’t immediately escape. Follow with Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Pantheon’s escape route, then attack in this order: basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack → basic attack. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking attacks from the front, wait for it to end or move around to the side and attack.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Use Trundle W Frozen Domain to keep up and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Pantheon’s path to block his escape. If you engage immediately when only Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, he can still escape with Pantheon R Grand Starfall.
Pantheon.fight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to reduce Pantheon’s attack damage. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault activates, wait to attack from the front or move around to the side. If Pantheon starts to flee, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions during Pantheon Q Comet Spear’s poke window. Trundle P King’s Tribute restores health when minions die, so if health has been lost, hold on while clearing the wave. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice in case the wave pushes out and leaves you exposed to a gank.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off later, and Trundle also contributes less to teamfights because he has no area damage, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Pantheon.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set the fight location, then split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and attack the isolated side first. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their armor and increase Trundle’s armor. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move out of its landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so be careful not to enter its range. Stand behind minions to reduce damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Stop attacking from the front while Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active and wait for it to end or move around to the side. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Quinn.build: Buy armor first. Quinn deals physical damage according to the data, so build armor as your resistance against her and don’t prioritize magic resistance.
Quinn.combo: When Quinn E Vault is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and follow up. Use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight, then place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Quinn’s escape path. Follow with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack → basic attack.
Quinn.escape: Your chance to engage comes right after Quinn uses Quinn E Vault. Use Trundle W Frozen Domain to close the gap and Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block her escape route. Don’t force an engage alone while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.fight: Engage right after Quinn E Vault is down. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then close in and use Trundle Q Chomp to increase your attack damage and slow Quinn. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Quinn’s escape path to block it.
Quinn.laning: Early on, last-hit without losing health within Quinn’s range. Back off when Quinn P Harrier marks you, and farm while the mark is absent. Keep the wave near the center and save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Trundle needs to preserve his health and hold on because Quinn has the range advantage.
Quinn.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their armor and increase Trundle’s armor. If Quinn comes in from the flank, disrupt her movement with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and fight her with your team.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, step outside her basic attack range to avoid the empowered attack. Quinn E Vault knocks Trundle back and creates distance when he closes in, so don’t force an engage while this ability is available. Stand behind a line of minions so a minion takes the first hit from Quinn Q Blinding Assault.

Renekton.build: Renekton heals with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, so fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Build armor first to counter Renekton’s main damage. However, empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so positioning to avoid that dash takes priority.
Renekton.combo: For a basic trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then use Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks in this order: basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp → basic attack. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down and you can stay on him, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route → Trundle Q Chomp.
Renekton.escape: Immediately after you bait out Renekton E Slice and Dice is your chance to close the gap. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator’s stun is down too, use Trundle W Frozen Domain to keep up and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in his escape path.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury or immediately after he has used all of Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. Against Renekton’s physical damage, hit him early with Trundle Q Chomp to reduce his attack damage, then keep using basic attacks inside Trundle W Frozen Domain. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Renekton.laning: Keep the wave near the center and save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense.
Renekton.phase: Trundle contributes less to teamfights later, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Renekton.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the separated side first. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their armor and increase Trundle’s armor.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger brings his Fury close to half, watch out for empowered abilities. In particular, stay outside the range of empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator to avoid its stun.

Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven starts getting ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build. Get health as well to avoid being vulnerable to the finishing damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Riven’s escape path, then attack in this order: basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack → basic attack.
Riven.escape: Even if Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions, don’t rush to chase if Riven E Valor is still available. In particular, look for a window before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back, and watch for her remaining mobility ability and whether she uses Riven W Ki Burst before engaging. If you’re at a disadvantage and need to disengage, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice between you and Riven.
Riven.fight: Look to trade right after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks to reduce her attack damage. If Riven engages first, use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to disrupt her follow-up engage.
Riven.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Riven when she steps up to last-hit. Don’t push too far beyond your vision while Riven Q Broken Wings is available. Don’t use Trundle E Pillar of Ice for every trade; save it for gank defense.
Riven.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, so take advantage of the downtime on Riven Q Broken Wings. He contributes less to teamfights later because he has no area damage, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Riven.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set the fight location, then split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and attack the isolated side first. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their armor and make yourself more durable. If Riven closes in, use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to disrupt the combination of Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven W Ki Burst.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings applies a knock-up at the end of its chain of dashes, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns. If a substantial amount of health has been lost, be especially careful of the finishing damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile.

Rumble.build: Buy a defensive item with magic resistance first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then attack in this order: basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack → basic attack. For a long fight, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Rumble’s escape path → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so look to engage after Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield and movement speed boost are gone. If you’re hit by the first charge of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance first to dodge the second, then block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice when you engage.
Rumble.fight: Start trading at a distance that forces Rumble to walk forward, so you don’t stay in Rumble Q Flamespitter for long. After the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield disappears, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and close in. Once you’ve caught him, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Rumble.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Rumble when he steps up to last-hit. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense, and if health has been lost, make use of the healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute when minions die.
Rumble.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, so apply brief pressure when Rumble steps forward. He contributes less to teamfights later because he has no area damage, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Rumble.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their armor and magic resistance, then take down the separated side first.
Rumble.watch: If you’re hit by the first charge of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, immediately create distance to dodge the second.
