Getting hit in succession strengthens the slow and reduces magic resistance, causing Rumble Q Flamespitter’s maximum health-based damage to hit harder. Watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer as well.

Sett.build: Build armor first to account for Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down damage. Lowering Sett’s attack speed to take fewer basic attacks is also effective. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, and resistances can’t reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so avoid the center instead of stacking only health.
Sett.combo: For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain first, then basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. When you can stay on him longer, use Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Sett’s escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack. Stop attacking when Sett W Haymaker becomes stronger, move sideways out of its center, then re-engage.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, it’s easier to engage without worrying about the stun.
Sett.fight: Place Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight as Sett goes for a last hit, or after Sett R The Show Stopper is down, then engage. Land Trundle Q Chomp early in the trade to reduce Sett’s attack damage. After dealing heavy damage, back off briefly to let the grit from Sett W Haymaker fade.
Sett.phase: Early on, Trundle is strong in trades using basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp, but avoid the stun area of Sett E Facebreaker and the center of Sett W Haymaker. Later, Trundle lacks area damage, so pin down one opponent in a side lane.
Sett.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set the area for the fight, then use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split Sett off from his team. Once the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their armor and raise Trundle’s armor. Watch where Sett R The Show Stopper could throw you toward your team, and avoid the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so don’t stand on the opposite side of Sett from a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker is dangerous right after he takes a lot of damage, so back off briefly. If you can’t avoid it, move to the side of the center line. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so watch where you’ll be thrown when Sett has R available.
Sett.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and pressure Sett on Trundle W Frozen Domain when he steps up to last-hit. Avoid standing on the opposite side of Sett from minions so Sett E Facebreaker can’t stun you. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for ganks instead of using it casually in trades. If your health has dropped, recover from the wave with Trundle P King’s Tribute.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on just one resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: When Shen E Shadow Dash misses and Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain under Shen and follow with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered attack → basic attack. If Shen starts to flee, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path. If you can fight for longer, use Trundle R Subjugate early to steal his armor and magic resistance.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to engage. However, Shen can also move with Shen R Stand United, so when Shen R Stand United is down, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Shen.fight: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and close in to trade. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, don’t rush your basic attacks; pressure him again with Trundle Q Chomp after it ends. If Shen R Stand United is also down, it’s a good time to block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Shen.laning: Keep the wave near the center and pressure Shen with Trundle W Frozen Domain and Trundle Q Chomp when he steps up to last-hit. If the lane is pushed out, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense. If Shen leaves lane with Shen R Stand United, push the wave then to gain a lane advantage.
Shen.phase: Early on, use Trundle’s strong basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp to pressure Shen’s last-hitting and gain lane control. Focus on objective fights in the mid game, then hold one opponent in place on a side lane later.
Shen.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the isolated side first. Once the fight starts, use Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their armor and magic resistance. Immediately alert your team if Shen shows signs of joining with Shen R Stand United.
Shen.watch: If you’re taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’re likely to get hit by empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so avoid the dash path. Also move out of the path of the Spirit Blade as it returns to Shen to reduce maximum health-based damage. When Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, hold off briefly on basic attacks, including Trundle Q Chomp.

Singed.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of the telegraphed poison trail. Build magic resistance against the damage from Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling. Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Singed.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp → basic attack. When Singed starts running, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path and hit the displaced Singed with Trundle Q Chomp. If you plan to use Trundle R Subjugate in the fight, cast it right after engaging to benefit from stealing armor and magic resistance.
Singed.escape: The window after Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down is a good time to engage. Singed has no skill to create distance on his own, so follow with Trundle W Frozen Domain and block his escape route with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Singed.fight: Early on, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and make a short trade when Singed steps forward to last-hit. Engage after dodging Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling, or confirming they’ve been used, then place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Singed’s path. Don’t chase for long along Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.laning: Trundle has no area-of-effect ability to push the wave, so keep it in the middle and stay close enough to engage when Singed steps up. If the lane is pushed and you’re exposed to a gank, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to use at the approach route.
Singed.phase: Later, Trundle’s lack of area damage reduces his teamfight impact, so pin down one opponent in a side lane.
Singed.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set the area for the fight. Hold an engaging Singed in place with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then attack the split enemy formation instead of chasing Singed to the end. Once the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase a fleeing Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. When Singed R Insanity Potion is active, his poison also applies Grievous Wounds, so stop chasing unless you have enough damage to finish him. Go around Singed W Mega Adhesive, and avoid positions where Singed E Fling could throw you toward his allies.

Sion.build: Build armor first against Sion’s main physical damage. Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t stop them. Sion E Roar of the Slayer also reduces armor, so prioritize dodging it. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of relying on a large health stack alone.
Sion.combo: To start a fight, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, use Trundle R Subjugate early, then place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Sion’s escape route. Weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is available, don’t assume Trundle E Pillar of Ice alone has blocked his escape.
Sion.escape: You can engage right after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash’s charge or making him end it early. If you place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in his escape route then, it will be difficult for Sion to get away.
Sion.fight: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side or make him use it early, then engage and fight. For a short trade, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then use basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp → basic attack. If Sion W Soul Furnace is active, take the opportunity to break its shield quickly and prevent the explosion.
Sion.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and pressure Sion with Trundle Q Chomp on Trundle W Frozen Domain when he steps up to last-hit. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense when the lane is pushed instead of using it all in routine trades. Sion gains maximum health from killing units, so don’t let him farm freely; push the wave to disrupt his farm or make gains in another lane.
Sion.phase: Early on, Trundle is strong in basic-attack fights, but apply short bursts of pressure while avoiding Sion’s crowd control. Later, consider pinning down Sion in a side lane as your teamfight impact decreases.
Sion.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set the area for the fight. Split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and engage the separated side first. Once the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on Sion in the front line to lower his defensive stats and raise Trundle’s defensive stats.
Sion.watch: If Sion Q Decimating Smash is charged for a long time, it also knocks you up and stuns you, so move to the side when the charge begins instead of only backing away. Choose your route to avoid meeting Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path, and dodge to the side once the charge begins. Even after Sion falls, Sion P Glory in Death revives him to attack, so don’t keep fighting in that spot.

Skarner.build: If you need to break free from Skarner R Impale, first decide whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Prioritize magic resistance among your defensive stats to counter Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and E Ixtal’s Impact deal physical damage, so magic resistance alone won’t stop them.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and use Trundle R Subjugate. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Skarner’s escape route, then use basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. For a short trade, use only Trundle W Frozen Domain → basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is your chance to engage. Follow with Trundle W Frozen Domain and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route. If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is available, he can cross the pillar, so make him use that mobility skill first.
Skarner.fight: Make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, then cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and engage. For a basic trade, use basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Skarner backs off, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path. If you have room for a longer fight, cast Trundle R Subjugate early to steal Skarner’s defensive stats.
Skarner.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and trade with Trundle Q Chomp on Trundle W Frozen Domain when Skarner steps up to last-hit. Position yourself so you aren’t cornered against a wall. If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is available, don’t use Trundle E Pillar of Ice for a risky trade. If health has decreased, use the healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute when minions die.
Skarner.phase: Early on, pressure Skarner when he steps up to last-hit with Trundle’s strong basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp. Skarner gets tankier and deals more damage as he builds tank items, so you need to delay his item timings. Later, focus on pinning down one opponent in a side lane.
Skarner.teamfight: Instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team to set the area for the fight. Split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and engage the isolated side first. Once the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on Skarner, who is now on the front line. Watch the distance between Skarner and his allies so Skarner R Impale doesn’t pull you away from your team.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact stuns you if you hit a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale drags you away if it catches you, so keep your distance from Skarner and his allies, and don’t stand right at the edge of an objective pit. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval empowered basic attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid staying in range and taking hits for long.

TahmKench.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Tahm Kench’s main damage from Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If the duel goes long, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items to reduce the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin. Tahm Kench has high armor, so consider penetration when dealing physical damage.
TahmKench.combo: When you have a chance to engage, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain beneath Tahm Kench and use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Tahm Kench’s escape route, then attack with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice on the path Tahm Kench is taking, not behind him.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging or escaping, so look for a chance to stick to him. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, stop engaging and wait outside his range for the stacks to disappear. When disengaging from a losing fight, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice between you and Tahm Kench.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn damage into a shield and healing, so fight when you can commit all at once instead of trading a few hits and backing off. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, and use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight to lower Tahm Kench’s armor while he has less chance to escape. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, don’t chase; create distance.
TahmKench.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and pressure Tahm Kench with Trundle Q Chomp on Trundle W Frozen Domain when he steps up to last-hit. Avoid staying in range to get hit repeatedly by Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If health has decreased, recover from the wave with Trundle P King’s Tribute. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense instead of using it for a risky trade.
TahmKench.phase: Early on, use Trundle’s strong basic attacks, but manage Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks as you fight. Later, Trundle lacks area damage, so focus on pinning down one opponent in a side lane.
TahmKench.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to separate Tahm Kench from the ally he is protecting. Once the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the durable front line to lower their armor and make yourself tankier. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for the chance he can save a carry before focusing your finishing attacks on them.
TahmKench.watch: If you think Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back off and wait for the stacks to disappear. Taking a third basic attack or Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash opens up an opportunity for a stun and Tahm Kench R Devour. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, create space to avoid the area knock-up at its landing point.

Teemo.build: Buy magic resistance items first against Teemo’s main damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Continue to prioritize magic resistance afterward.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. For a longer fight, use Trundle R Subjugate right after engaging, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of Teemo’s escape route, then land Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Teemo.escape: Engage right after Teemo uses Teemo Q Blinding Dart. Teemo has no way to get away other than Teemo W Move Quick, so close the distance and block his escape route with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, then engage all at once and deal damage with basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp. If Teemo flees with Teemo W Move Quick, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his path.
Teemo.laning: Avoid trades where Teemo E Toxic Shot hits you with one poisoned basic attack and you back off. Keep the wave in the middle and pressure from a distance where you can engage. Watch whether Teemo uses Blinding Dart when he steps up to last-hit. If your jungler comes, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in Teemo’s escape route.
Teemo.phase: Early on, Trundle has strong basic attacks, but avoid basic-attack fights while Teemo Q Blinding Dart is available. Later, Trundle’s area damage contribution in teamfights decreases, so pin down one opponent in a side lane.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap in front of objectives and in narrow paths. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team, split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, then cast Trundle R Subjugate on the front line once the fight starts.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart nullifies Trundle’s basic attacks, so don’t try to basic attack while blinded. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies lingering poison damage with even one basic attack, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to engage. Watch out for hidden Teemo R Noxious Trap in front of objectives and in narrow paths.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Since he relies heavily on basic attacks, Thornmail is effective. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Tryndamere.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. When you can commit to the fight, use Trundle R Subjugate early after Trundle W Frozen Domain. If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, chase by placing Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after you make Tryndamere use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your chance to engage. Follow with Trundle W Frozen Domain and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in his escape route. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, it reduces your attack damage, so don’t immediately start a basic-attack fight.
Tryndamere.fight: Trade briefly when Tryndamere steps up to last-hit before he builds Fury. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and land Trundle Q Chomp early to reduce his attack damage. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and fight again after its duration ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, pressure Tryndamere so he can’t last-hit comfortably, suppressing both his Fury and healing. Keep the wave near the middle and stay within engage range. If the lane is pushed and you’re exposed to a gank, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to use at the approach route.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, Trundle can pressure with basic-attack fights, but watch for the moment Tryndamere builds Fury. Later, Trundle’s teamfight impact decreases and side-lane play becomes more important, but don’t go after Tryndamere alone if Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice. Once the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy front line to lower their defensive stats and raise Trundle’s defensive stats. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and wait it out instead of focusing damage on him.
Tryndamere.watch: Watch out for Tryndamere P Battle Fury critical strikes and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust healing. Create distance when Tryndamere starts building Fury by attacking minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can’t die during its duration, so use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to slow his pursuit and create distance instead of pouring damage into him.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s basic-attack focused damage. If Udyr sustains through healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Armor alone can’t block all the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and mixed damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw.
Udyr.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, and use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight while Udyr has less chance to escape. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice in front of his escape route. Weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks and keep attacking.
Udyr.escape: The window to engage comes right after you’ve taken one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede or made him use it for mobility. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, so block his path with Trundle E Pillar of Ice after the Awakened effect ends. When disengaging, also place Trundle E Pillar of Ice between you and the pursuing Udyr.
Udyr.fight: Take one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then counterattack. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, keep using basic attacks inside Trundle W Frozen Domain and don’t give him a chance to heal. After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, block his escape route with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so keep vision on key routes and jungle entrances, and don’t step forward when he’s missing. Keep the wave in the middle and apply pressure, but save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to stop a gank. If health has decreased, use Trundle P King’s Tribute to heal as you clear the wave.
Udyr.phase: Trundle is strong in basic-attack fights early on, but don’t move forward if you can’t see Udyr’s gank path. Later, Trundle lacks area damage, so pin down one opponent in a side lane.
Udyr.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team and use Trundle E Pillar of Ice to split Udyr from the enemies behind him. Once the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the durable Udyr to lower his armor and raise Trundle’s armor. Instead of trying to force your way through the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle, clear the weaker, separated enemies first, then take Udyr down with a numbers advantage.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the distance and stuns you, so keep your distance just after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid taking hits for long. Pressure him after the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone.

Urgot.build: Build armor first, since Urgot P Echoing Flames, Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, and Urgot W Purge deal most of their damage as physical damage. Be careful about stacking health alone, because Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with your maximum health. Add penetration against Urgot's high armor, and lower his armor with Trundle R Subjugate during fights.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and use Trundle R Subjugate early. Place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of Urgot's escape direction, then follow with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. Don’t place Trundle E Pillar of Ice behind Urgot and leave his escape route open.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so engage right after he uses it. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge also missed, the risk of being caught by its heavy slow is lower. At that point, block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and stick to him on Trundle W Frozen Domain.
Urgot.fight: Right after Urgot E Disdain is down is your chance to close the gap. Before then, stay outside Urgot's short range, and walk away to create distance if Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active. When you fight, first choose where to cast Trundle W Frozen Domain, then weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks.
Urgot.laning: Farm with the wave in the center, keeping Urgot E Disdain's engage range in mind. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice for gank defense or to block Urgot's escape after Urgot E Disdain is down, rather than spending it on trades. If health has decreased, you can sustain with Trundle P King's Tribute, which triggers when nearby minions die.
Urgot.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, but melee champions have a hard time fighting Urgot head-on for long. Your teamfight impact falls later, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Urgot.teamfight: Instead of walking straight at Urgot, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation to choose where to fight. Split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and take down one side first; when the fight starts, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so having your frontline stand ahead can keep allies behind them from getting caught.
Urgot.watch: If Urgot E Disdain catches you, you can easily take follow-up attacks while stunned, so avoid his dash angles and keep your distance. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows you, making it harder to escape, and also designates you as a target for Urgot W Purge, so dodging it is important. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before you reach the execute threshold.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Keep in mind that armor cannot block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: If you can keep fighting, use Trundle R Subjugate early in the fight and place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of Yasuo's retreat direction.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his whirlwind, he has no way to knock you up for a while, giving you a chance to engage. One use of Yasuo E Sweeping Blade being down isn't enough; look to engage with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back, and block his escape with Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Yasuo.fight: Strip the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with a basic attack first, then commit immediately after Yasuo throws his whirlwind. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight, and use Trundle Q Chomp early in the trade to reduce Yasuo's attack damage.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave near the center but let it push slightly toward your side to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to approach. Save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block the entry path if the lane pushes and leaves you exposed to a gank; don't spend it on trades.
Yasuo.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, but using Trundle E Pillar of Ice often will quickly drain your mana, so trade carefully. Your teamfight impact falls later because you have no area damage, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Yasuo.teamfight: Trundle has no dash, so instead of walking straight in, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation to choose where to fight. Split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice and take down the separated side first; once the fight is underway, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, his next whirlwind knocks you up, so watch for the effect and dodge sideways out of its line. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to approach, and once he catches you, Trundle has no skill to get away on his own, so managing distance is important.

Yone.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of telegraphed attack zones. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Attack speed reduction also helps by slowing the cooldowns of Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave.
Yone.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight first, then attack with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If Yone still has a mobility skill, don't assume one Trundle E Pillar of Ice completely blocks his escape.
Yone.escape: The opening to engage comes after the whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel disappears and Yone E Soul Unbound is down. If Yone R Fate Sealed hasn't returned yet, Trundle E Pillar of Ice is good for blocking his escape. If only one of Yone's mobility skills is down, he can escape with another, so don't rush your engage.
Yone.fight: Don't engage first while the whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready. After the whirlwind disappears and Yone steps up to last-hit, cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and make a short trade with basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp. If Yone starts to use a mobility skill to escape, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his path.
Yone.laning: Back off when the whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready, and keep the wave in the center to leave room to engage and retreat. If the lane is pushed and you are vulnerable to a gank, save Trundle E Pillar of Ice to block the entry path.
Yone.phase: Use Trundle's strong basic attacks to pressure early, but avoid fighting while the whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready. Your area damage falls short later, so shift to holding one opponent in place on a side lane.
Yone.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, engaging one side first. Once the fight is underway, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the tanky frontline to lower the opponent's defensive stats and increase Trundle's defensive stats. Keep some distance from allies so multiple people aren't hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and don't stay alone in the backline in case of Yone R Fate Sealed.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his whirlwind, stay out of range until the stacks disappear. After Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, he deals additional damage when he returns, so create distance early if health has decreased. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don't stand alone in the backline before a teamfight.

Yorick.build: Build armor first, since Yorick Q Last Rites and Mist Walkers' attacks deal physical damage. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Armor alone can't counter Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles, so consider magic resistance as well.
Yorick.combo: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain and trade with basic attack → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack → basic attack. If you have an opening to stick to Yorick and fight, engage with Trundle W Frozen Domain → Trundle R Subjugate → Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape route → Trundle Q Chomp empowered basic attack.
Yorick.escape: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and move into range while Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no mobility, so once you're on him, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his escape direction.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, start the fight where there are fewer Mist Walkers. Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain where you plan to fight and weave Trundle Q Chomp between basic attacks. If Yorick retreats, place Trundle E Pillar of Ice ahead of his path to catch him.
Yorick.laning: Don't fight where Yorick has built up many graves. Trundle has no skill to push the lane with area damage, so keep the wave in the center and pressure Yorick when he steps up to last-hit. Push and recall when Yorick leaves the lane or retreats because his health has decreased.
Yorick.phase: Trundle is strong in basic attack fights early, but avoid fighting where Yorick has built up graves. Your area damage is lacking later, so hold one opponent in place on a side lane.
Yorick.teamfight: Cast Trundle W Frozen Domain in front of your team's formation and split the enemy formation with Trundle E Pillar of Ice, taking down the separated side first. Once the fight is underway, cast Trundle R Subjugate on the enemy frontline to lower their defensive stats and make yourself tankier.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you and deals damage based on your maximum health, so watch the projectile's path and dodge it. If you are trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it, and create distance from Yorick himself if the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you.
